content: {"action":"plan","payload_json":"[{\"requirement_id\":\"req-microsoft-cloud\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\",\"description\":\"Microsoft FY2025 10-K: original definition of the Microsoft Cloud revenue metric (which offerings it includes) and the disclosed FY2025 Microsoft Cloud revenue amount and growth rate, with the FY2025 vs FY2024 period context and units.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req-intelligent-cloud\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\",\"description\":\"Microsoft FY2025 10-K: definition of the Intelligent Cloud reporting segment (principal products, services and activities in its enumeration) and its FY2025 segment revenue and operating income amounts and growth rates, with units.\"},{\"requirement_id\":\"req-azure\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"source-360182cbf562dcf9a8ab9c4e\",\"description\":\"Microsoft FY2025 10-K: definition of Azure and other cloud services (its composition within Intelligent Cloud server products and cloud services) and the disclosed FY2025 growth rate for Azure and other cloud services; check whether a standalone Azure revenue amount is disclosed, without estimating one.\"}]","reason":"Plan three source_evidence requirements covering the definitions and FY2025 disclosed metrics for Microsoft Cloud, Intelligent Cloud and Azure, keeping the three scopes distinct.","requirement_ids":[]}
